audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison is called a flat 'point-blank root' everywhere, including the focus string, and Overload is treated as a spell with a normal cooldown you can punish.
audit.why: Rune Prison (W, 615 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) only roots if the target already has Flux on them — otherwise it damages and slows. Spell Flux (E, 615 range, 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5s) is what applies Flux, and Ryze's other basic abilities reset Overload's cooldown, so 'punish his Q cooldown' is not a real window. The actual counterplay is to avoid eating Spell Flux, because without it the W cannot hold you still for the chain.
audit.corrected: Dodge Spell Flux and Rune Prison is only a slow; the root is the E-into-W sequence, not the W alone.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagree between layers: full reads Annie, Annie, Annie, Skill, Annie, Ryze, Ryze while content reads Skill, Skill, Skill, Annie, Annie, Annie, Annie. The full layer even hands Ryze the first-item row that phases[5].why describes as Annie's Luden's spike.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly, and at 57.47% over 783 games Annie owning levels 4 onward is the right shape — Ryze's real spike is three-plus items, which is past the last chart row.
audit.corrected: Flip the full layer to Skill, Skill, Skill, Annie, Annie, Annie, Annie.

audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 understates it slightly at 57.47%, but the lane genuinely is a range war Annie loses on paper (1000 vs 625) and wins the moment Ryze is inside Flash range with Pyromania banked.

audit.whatIsWrong: Realm Warp is described as giving him 'mobility'.
audit.why: Realm Warp (180/160/140s, 3000 range) creates a portal that teleports allies standing near it after a delay — it is a squad repositioning tool on a very long cooldown, not a lane escape.
audit.corrected: Treat Realm Warp as a map-pressure cooldown to track, not as an escape he can use against your all-in.

notes: Central correction: Rune Prison is not an unconditional root. It roots only if Spell Flux is already on the target, otherwise it damages and slows — so the counterplay this page never stated is dodging the E, not the W. Related: 'punish his Q cooldown windows' was unsound advice because Ryze's other abilities reset Overload. Level chart disagreed on six of seven rows; content matches packet.levelChart, so the full layer was flipped as one atomic group. Note the focus string is 'Ryze Rune Prison (Root)' and the same '(Root)' label appears in loading, winCon and several report entries — those are champion-level focus strings I did not edit, but the label is misleading and the user may want the focus retargeted to Spell Flux.
